description: This file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android TV application, serving as the main home screen. It manages a focusable UI with a hero banner carousel, 'Continue Watching' and 'TV Channels' horizontal rails, including auto-scroll behavior, focus navigation, and data loading via a ViewModel and Repositories. It also includes a Compose-based top navigation bar integrated into a traditional View hierarchy.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment serving as the main home screen for a TV app, incorporating a hero carousel, focus navigation, and content rails with dynamic data loading.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the repository and ViewModel for data management.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Constructs and returns the view hierarchy, sets up focus navigation, and initializes UI components.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets initial focus, observes data states, triggers data load.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes hero auto-scrolling and focus when returning to the fragment.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops auto-scrolling when paused.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Observes LiveData for UI state updates and refreshes content rails accordingly.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays the loading indicator for the Continue Watching section.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides the loading indicator for the Continue Watching section.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays the loading indicator for the TV Channels section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides the loading indicator for the TV Channels section.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Displays an error message with a retry prompt.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates the Continue Watching rail with data and updates focus routing.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates the TV Channels rail with data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds a Compose-based top navigation bar, handling initial focus and navigation.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Sets up the hero carousel with auto-scroll, focus management, and full-width display.

methods.name: centerHeroAt
methods.description: Centers the hero carousel on a specific card, leaving partial peek of neighboring cards.

methods.name: pauseAutoScrollForUserInteraction
methods.description: Pauses auto-scrolling of hero carousel during user interaction.

methods.name: startHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Begins auto-scroll of the hero carousel at configured intervals.

methods.name: stopHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Stops auto-scrolling of the hero carousel.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Initializes the Continue Watching horizontal content rail with loading indicator.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Initializes the TV Channels horizontal content rail with loading indicator.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focus for the content rails based on user interaction state.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Utility function to convert density-independent pixels to pixels.
